name: delete-organization
description: Permanently delete an organization by its unique identifier. This action cannot be undone. The organization will be completely removed from the system. May fail if the organization has dependencies or relationships with other entities.

id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to delete (required). This is the ID of the organization you want to permanently remove from the system.

annotations.note: This operation is permanent and cannot be undone. Ensure the organization ID is correct before deleting.

errors.description: Organization not found with the specified ID
Cannot delete organization due to existing dependencies

error.message: Cannot delete organization with existing dependencies

details.reason: Organization has active projects or users associated with it

errors.description: Insufficient permissions to delete this organization
